description: This source file defines an Android Fragment named BrowseFragment that displays media items retrieved via MediaBrowser in a list view. It manages connection callbacks to the media service, handles list item clicks to select media, and includes an internal adapter class for rendering list items.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that connects to a MediaBrowserService, displays a list of browsable media items, and handles user interactions.

classes.name: BrowseFragment.BrowseAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that renders MediaBrowser.MediaItem objects into list view items, showing title, description, and play icon.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new browsing fragment with specified media ID.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the list adapter and item click handler, and initializes MediaBrowser.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the MediaBrowser when fragment starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the MediaBrowser when fragment stops.
